description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related nested classes within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. It provides interfaces and implementations for system information components such as identifiers, provisioning, internet, security, location, time, and event handling for system state changes. The class manages notifications, maintains internal state, and exposes methods to retrieve system info objects.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class managing system information and notifications, providing access to various system components and handling system state change events.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents a system identifier, managing device ID, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Provisioning
classes.description: Handles provisioning information, including storage labels.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Provides internet connectivity information such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Stores geographic location details including timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client for system events.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SecurityCallsign
methods.description: Returns the callsign associated with system security.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Set
methods.description: Handles system event updates, setting internal state based on event type and associated information.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current system information object for a given subsystem type.

methods.name: SystemInfo::IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a subsystem type is active.

methods.name: SystemInfo::BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Builds a hash representing the system info tree.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the system info.
